Edulixa · Interactive Storybook

Paste your story, then build the pictures inside the book

  1. Copy your story and paste it below.
  2. Press Load story. The book opens with a prompt on every picture page.
  3. On each picture page: Copy prompt → make the picture in Gemini → ＋ Add picture.
  4. Press Download book when you are done.
